about: Figures for osek-zair.html that no text read in this repository states. osek-zair.html renders none of them and no page or module loads this file; CONFIG_PUBLISH_RULES gives it the 'verified' rule, so a shipped page that loaded it would stop the build. A value leaves this file only when a rendered text states it: then it moves into osek-zair.json with that capture's line as its cite, and is deleted here. The 2026 cap left on 29.9.2026: nevo's consolidated text of the VAT law (research/rendered/nevo-vat-law.txt:93, current to 13-07-2026) states it, and osek-zair.json `years` now carries it with that cite (record: logs/2026-09-29-osek-zair-2026.md).

vatLawSense.grade: statute mirror quoted in the repo, not rendered: research/colony-sweep/scouts/risk-governance--selling-as-individual.md:132 quotes תקנות מע"מ (רישום) 15א(ג) ("עוסק זעיר לענין סעיף 31(3) לחוק"); research/tiktok/08-reads/hebrew-israel.md:244 repeats it.
vatLawSense.why: The task asked the page to say that עוסק זעיר in VAT law (section 31(3)) is a different thing. The distinction is on the page in words, marked as secondary; the section number is held here because no capture of the VAT law or its regulations has been read.
vatLawSense.toVerify: Render a primary copy of the VAT law (section 31) or of תקנות מע"מ (רישום), cite the line, and move the section reference into osek-zair.json.
vatLawSense.seenSince: 29.9.2026, while moving the 2026 cap: nevo's consolidated VAT law (research/rendered/nevo-vat-law.txt, current to 13-07-2026) reads '"עוסק זעיר" – (נמחקה)' at line 89, section 31(3) at line 484 reads 'עסקאות של עוסק פטור', and the headings at lines 610 and 782 name עוסק זעיר over repealed sections 42 and 57. That points the other way from the secondary sentence the page carries (secondary.vatSense in osek-zair.json); it was seen, not read against the regulations, and nothing on the page was changed for it.
